This is a separate project rather than an addition to tsconfig.json on purpose:
that config is also what `next build` typechecks, and Playwright specs have no
business in the production build's project.
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is deliberately off HERE and stays on for src. It

index arrays they just built themselves (`const [r,g,b] = parse(str)`, a 1x1

measurement specs buys nothing, while the flag keeps its real value in src.
